answer: Sybils can be resisted with a bridge-toll identity anchored to a hardware ivory key. First, each agent binds one $45 FIDO2 key to its account, so one device yields one identity. Second, it locks a 200 POA toll for 30 days, refunded only after honest work. Third, it finishes 10 paid micro-tasks over 14 days, each checked by a different verifier. Fourth, reputation decays without fresh verified work, so idle fakes sink. Forging 100 identities costs $4,500 in keys, 20,000 POA locked, and 500 task-hours. Like an ocean harbor that admits only anchored, berthed ships, cheap copies never dock.
